title: SunSpec Explorer recording line
description: ONE LINE of a recording of the OT Fabric SunSpec Explorer (schema identifier otfabric.sunspec-explorer.recording/1). A recording is JSON Lines: a header line, then sample and event lines, then a footer line. A recording without footer was interrupted (crash or kill); its last line may then be truncated and is to be ignored. A recording split into several files (<name>.000.jsonl, <name>.001.jsonl, ...) has one header, in the first file, and one footer, in the last. Validate each line on its own. All timestamps are UTC, RFC 3339. All register addresses are zero-based Modbus addresses.

RecordingHeader.description: The first line: what is recorded, and with what.

interval_s.description: Poll interval in seconds when the recording started; 0 when polling was not running then (a polling_started event follows).

device.description: Identification from the Common model, or null when the device has none or it could not be read.

models.description: The model chain when the recording started. A discovery_changed event replaces it.

seq.description: Number of the sample within its polling run, starting at 1. It starts again at 1 when polling is started again.

captured_at.description: Start of the first request of the cycle. Models are read one after another: a sample is not an atomic view of the device.

overruns.description: Poll ticks skipped so far in this polling run because a cycle was still running.

metadata.description: Recordings carry no point metadata: the model IDs and the library version in the header identify the schema.

models.description: The models of this cycle. Static-only models are in the first sample of a run only, unless they were selected.

RecordingEvent.description: Something that explains a gap or a change in the samples around it.

kind.description: What happened. Known kinds: gap (polling is not running, or was stopped), polling_started, reconnecting (the device stopped answering), connected (it answers again), discovery_changed (the model chain was discovered again; models holds the new chain). Readers must tolerate kinds they do not know.

models.description: The new model chain after a discovery_changed event. The index of the models in later samples refers to it.

RecordingFooter.description: The last line of a recording that was stopped.

samples.description: Number of sample lines in the recording.

failures.description: Number of samples in which at least one model was not ok.

reason.description: user: stopped by the user. limit: size, total size or age limit. disk_space: the free-space floor was reached. session_closed: the session was closed. shutdown: the engine was shut down. error: a write failed.

AppInfo.description: The application that wrote the file.

LibInfo.description: The libraries that decoded the data.

go_sunspec.description: Version of the go-sunspec library that decoded the data.

registry_models.description: Number of SunSpec model schemas the library knows.

url.description: tcp://host:port, rtuovertcp://host:port, tcp+tls://host:port or rtu://<device>; never with credentials.

DeviceIdentity.description: Identification points of the Common model (model 1).

ModelInfo.description: One model instance found by discovery.

index.description: Position in the model chain. A device can hold several models with the same id.

start_address.description: Address of the model's ID register.

length.description: Number of data registers after the ID and length registers.

schema_known.description: The library has a schema of this model ID.

static_only.description: The model holds nothing that changes by itself (as Common): it is read once, not in every poll cycle.

ModelResult.description: The outcome of reading one model instance.

index.description: Position in the model chain. A device can hold several models with the same id.

start_address.description: Address of the model's ID register.

length.description: Number of data registers after the ID and length registers.

status.description: changed: the device no longer holds this model at this address.

error.description: Why the read failed; null when status is ok.

stale.description: While polling: the last good read of the model is older than two poll intervals.

last_ok_at.description: Time of the last good read of the model in this session; omitted when there was none.

group.description: The decoded model, or null when it was not decoded (no schema, or the read failed).

raw_registers.description: Data registers of a model without schema, or of every model when the request asked for them; otherwise null.

GroupView.description: One decoded group instance: its points and the group instances nested in it.

index.description: 1-based instance number within the parent; 0 for the top-level group.

type.description: SunSpec point type, for example int16, acc32, enum16, sunssf, string.

implemented.description: false: the device reports the SunSpec not-implemented value; raw then holds that sentinel, not a measurement.

raw.description: Unscaled value: a number, a string, a list of registers for a type that is not decoded, or null for a float that is not a number.

scaled.description: raw times 10^sf_raw, or null without a resolved scale factor.

sf_name.description: Name of the scale factor point.

sf_raw.description: Value of the scale factor point.

symbols.description: Names of the active enum value or bitfield flags.

address.description: Absolute address of the point's first register.

offset.description: Register offset from the model's ID register.
